name: Grok
description: Adds Grok (xAI) as a selectable session provider, over its OpenAI-compatible legacy chat-completions endpoint (api.x.ai/v1) via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. Chat-only: no tool calls, file access or permission prompts. Configure an xAI API key and model (e.g. grok-4.6) per profile in Manage profiles. Experimental.
author: Cockpit
